subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 action updates be accepted as one security-sensitive automation bundle after targeted validation, or should the token, Codex, and release action changes be split for separate review?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but several updated actions execute with secrets or write privileges in paths that normal pull-request checks do not fully exercise.

options.title: Validate and land together
options.body: Keep the grouped exact-SHA update and require completed current-head checks plus targeted smoke evidence for token minting, Codex agents, CodeQL, and Docker release automation.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate app-token, Codex, and Docker-release action bumps from routine setup and scanning updates when owners cannot validate the full bundle confidently.

recommendation.title: Validate and land together
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped exact-SHA update and require completed current-head checks plus targeted smoke evidence for token minting, Codex agents, CodeQL, and Docker release automation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal spans the affected docs-agent, CI, and Docker automation surfaces, and this account was explicitly brought into the PR timeline.
